# World Population Review

> > World Population Review provides comprehensive, up-to-date population statistics and demographic data for countries, cities, states, and regions worldwide, with 2026 projections based on UN and census data.

World Population Review is a leading source for global demographic information, offering detailed population rankings, country profiles, and regional statistics. The site aggregates data from authoritative sources including the United Nations, US Census Bureau, and American Community Survey to deliver accurate population projections and comparative demographic analysis.

## Global Population Overview

- [Current World Population: 8,298,978,817](https://worldpopulationreview.com): Homepage tracking global population with stats for India, China, US, Indonesia, Pakistan
- [Population by Continent 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents): Continental population data for Asia, Africa, Europe, North America with 2026 projections
- [Total Population by Country 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries): Country population rankings and statistics for 2026 with demographic comparisons

## Country Profiles

- [India Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/india): India country profile with New Delhi capital and Asian demographic statistics
- [China Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/china): China country profile with Beijing capital and Eastern Asia population data
- [United States Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/united-states): United States population profile with Washington capital and North America data
- [Indonesia Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/indonesia): Indonesia country statistics featuring Jakarta capital and Southeast Asia data
- [Pakistan Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/pakistan): Pakistan population profile with Islamabad capital and Southern Asia demographics
- [Nigeria Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/nigeria): Nigeria country profile with Abuja capital and Western Africa population statistics
- [Brazil Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/brazil): Brazil country profile with Brasília capital and South America demographic data
- [Bangladesh Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/bangladesh): Bangladesh country profile featuring Dhaka capital and Southern Asia statistics
- [Russia Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/russia): Russia country profile with Moscow capital spanning Asia and Eastern Europe
- [Ethiopia Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/ethiopia): Ethiopia country profile with Addis Ababa capital and Eastern Africa demographics

## Cities and Urban Areas

- [Largest Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities): Global city rankings including Tokyo, Delhi, Shanghai, Dhaka, Cairo for 2026
- [Largest US Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/us-cities): Largest US cities ranking: New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Phoenix

## United States Demographics

- [US States - Ranking by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/states): US state population rankings for California, Texas, Florida, New York, Pennsylvania
- [US County Populations 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/us-counties): US county population data including Los Angeles, Cook, Harris counties for 2026
- [ZIP Codes by Population](https://worldpopulationreview.com/zips): ZIP code population statistics across Texas, New Jersey, Illinois, New York, California

## Resources and Methodology

- [World Population Review Methodology](https://worldpopulationreview.com/methodology): Data sources and methodology using UN, US Census Bureau, American Community Survey
- [Categories](https://worldpopulationreview.com/categories): Content directory covering Big Mac Index, Environmental Performance, Military Strength
